page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the last letters or words of most lines (for example "genera", "Apostc", "constitutione", "commend", "lon", "possu"). These ends are marked [?] or cut at the scan edge and could not be read; the printed words likely continue beyond the crop. "approb" and "quan" are partly visible and uncertain. Lines 1 and "ecclesiæ" at the start of the last line are partly cut at the left edge as well.
